english.title: Fail to give notice to Environment Agency of proposal to instal gauge to measure flow, level or volume of inland waters
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having proposed to install a gauge for measuring and recording the flow, level or volume of inland waters other than discrete waters, failed to give notice to the appropriate agency, namely **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), of your proposal to install the gauge
english.legislation: Contrary to section 200(1)(a) and (4) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
